props.gloss_en: one who stores [an item] for sowing, as a sample, or for medicine, and carried it out on Shabbat, is liable for any amount
and any [other] person is liable for it only at its measure
if he went back and brought it in, he is liable only at its measure
Abaye: the mishna deals with one who stored it and forgot why he stored it, and now carries it out without purpose
Abaye: whoever acts [with something], acts on his first intention -- so the forgotten storing purpose is not nullified
R' Meir held liable even one who carries out a single wheat seed for sowing
there [one who planned to carry out his whole house], his intention is void against that of all people

objections.gloss_en: מתקיף לה: אלא מעתה, חישב להוציא כל ביתו -- הכי נמי דלא מיחייב עד דמפיק לכוליה?! -- if a person's purpose sets the measure, one who planned to carry out his whole house would not be liable until he carried all of it
